title: Koma Motion project, format version 5
description: A Koma Motion project file (.koma). Generated from the runtime schema; do not edit by hand. Run `pnpm schema:generate` to update it. Koma Motion validates further rules at runtime that JSON Schema cannot express; see docs/PROJECT_FORMAT.md.

additionalProperties.description: Extension data: unknown top-level properties are kept when the project is saved. Values must be JSON, nested at most 32 levels, with at most 10,000 values per property, at most 1,000 properties per object and property names of at most 256 characters.
